There are some major differences between these two fighting techniques. Even though for their time they are the most advanced. As you can see, the Greek hoplites are heavily armored. And as such, each hoplite needs to buy his own armor which means that hoplites tend to be small landowners with a bit of wealth. The legionnaires can be poor because it doesn't actually require that much armor to be a legionnaire.

The first thing is that it takes a lot of training to be a hoplite. You basically have to spend years and years honing your skills because you fight in formation. The legionnaire, on the other hand, you don't need that much training. You can actually go straight into battle. The third major difference is that as you can see, the hoplites use heavy armor shields and helmets. The legionnaires are much lighter. This is because the legionnaires were developed to fight in a mountainous region. So they need to be able to climb and hike up mountains in formation whereas the Greeks are fighting more on flat land.

Over time what will happen is that the legionnaires will overwhelm the hoplites. This is a typical Roman peasant. He spends most of his time farming and when it's required of him, he goes to war. He's not a full-time soldier. The Greeks and Romans will fight a series of wars. As the Romans are expanding, they go closer and closer to the coast where there are many Greek colonies. And the Greeks are losing to the Romans. So they call for help from their compatriots across the sea, and a king named Pyrus of Epirus decides to take advantage of this opportunity to go conquer Italy.

So he and his hoplites sail over to Greece and they are destroying the Romans. Battle after battle, Pyrus is defeating the Romans. And then he finally says, "You know what? If I win one more battle, I'm going to have no more soldiers." This shows you the difference between Greek fighting versus Roman fighting. Greek fighting uses specialized forces that can win over time, whereas the Romans can just keep on replenishing their forces.

The Romans don't actually win many battles but they win most of their wars. Now as the Romans are expanding, they eventually reach the Mediterranean and start developing a navy in order to trade with nations like Egypt and Greece. This comes into conflict with the Carthaginians who are the main power in the Mediterranean at this time. The main reason why Rome triumphs is because Carthage is rich and can hire mercenaries to fight the war for them, whereas Rome must use its own citizens to fight the war.
